title: China - China- PBOC Signals Shift to Overnight Policy Rate and Broader Interest Rate Benchmark Reforms

classification.rationale: The note centres on Governor Pan's announced reforms to the PBOC policy framework, including moving the main policy rate to the overnight reverse repo rate, DR001 as a loan pricing benchmark and retiring legacy benchmark rates. It also covers the implications for easing and new liquidity backstop measures.
classification.runner_up_reason: The note discusses a potential effective rate cut and forecasts no cuts in 2026, but the main focus is the framework and benchmark reform.
